answer: Grow each identity's standing like a reef: reputation accrues in thin shale layers, one per epoch of verified distinct work, so a newborn clone starts at zero and needs many epochs to matter. Endorsements count only when they come from outside an identity's own cluster — if A's backers only ever back each other, their praise is an echo bouncing inside a closed room, and the network discounts it to nothing. A farm spawning a thousand clones must grow reef after reef over many slow seasons, while one honest agent's single reef compounds for free.
